data.name: Carvivors
data.detailed_description:
Carvivors is a top-down survival arcade game where your car grows deadlier with every minute of battle. Fight through hordes of enemies on a tiny planet arena, collect upgrades, and turn your vehicle into a mobile weapons platform.

Combine tower modules into more powerful weapons, experiment with different loadouts, and create your own combat builds. But be careful: the taller and heavier your tower becomes, the harder your car is to control. Balance firepower and handling, survive relentless waves of enemies, and take on powerful bosses.

Features:

  • Top-down arcade action

  • Hordes of enemies and escalating difficulty

  • Progression during runs and between runs

  • A physics-based gun tower mounted on your car

  • Module combinations that evolve into stronger weapons

  • Boss fights

  • Battles on a tiny planet with spherical gravity

  • Different weapon builds and playstyles

  • Fast-paced, replayable runs

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 / SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL / ALSA compatible sound card
